tasks.title: repair mean calculation
tasks.prompt: Fix mean so empty input returns None and nonempty small i64 input returns the arithmetic mean as f64. Preserve the public signature.
tasks.initial_source: pub fn mean(values: &[i64]) -> Option<f64> { if values.is_empty() { return None; } Some(values.iter().sum::<i64>() as f64 / (values.len() + 1) as f64) }
tasks.reference_source: pub fn mean(values: &[i64]) -> Option<f64> { if values.is_empty() { return None; } Some(values.iter().sum::<i64>() as f64 / values.len() as f64) }
tasks.grader_source: #[cfg(test)] mod grading { use super::*; #[test] fn empty(){assert_eq!(mean(&[]),None);} #[test] fn values(){assert_eq!(mean(&[2,4]),Some(3.0));assert_eq!(mean(&[-2,2]),Some(0.0));assert_eq!(mean(&[7]),Some(7.0));} }

tasks.title: parse a validated port
tasks.prompt: Implement parse_port. Trim ASCII whitespace, accept nonempty ASCII decimal digits and leading zeros in range 0..65535. Reject signs, embedded spaces, non-ASCII digits, alternate bases and out-of-range values. Preserve the public signature.
tasks.initial_source: pub fn parse_port(_input: &str) -> Result<u16, &'static str> { Err("not implemented") }
tasks.reference_source: pub fn parse_port(input: &str) -> Result<u16, &'static str> { let s=input.trim_matches(|c: char| c.is_ascii_whitespace()); if s.is_empty() || !s.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()) { return Err("invalid port"); } s.parse::<u16>().map_err(|_| "invalid port") }
tasks.grader_source: #[cfg(test)] mod grading { use super::*; #[test] fn valid(){for (s,v) in [("0",0),("65535",65535),(" 80\n",80),("00080",80)]{assert_eq!(parse_port(s),Ok(v));}} #[test] fn invalid(){for s in ["", "  ", "-1", "+1", "65536", "8 0", "１２", "0x50", "\u{a0}80"]{assert!(parse_port(s).is_err(),"{s}");}} }
